option_relations.rationale: Cardiac arrhythmia (other than heart block) is a broad category of heart rhythm disorders. Vasovagal syncope is a reflex syncope, not primarily an arrhythmia in this context.
Trifascicular block is a specific cardiac conduction abnormality. Vasovagal syncope is a neurally mediated syncope, not a conduction block.
Intermittent complete heart block is a severe cardiac conduction disorder. Vasovagal syncope is a reflex syncope, not a heart block.
High-grade atrioventricular (AV) block is a cardiac conduction abnormality. Vasovagal syncope is a reflex syncope, not an AV block.
